amenitiesDescription: The full amenity program will be confirmed upon official launch. Publicly disclosed planning points to a five-star global hospitality flag (brand to be announced), a 13.3-acre public waterfront park designed and funded by the developer partnership, adjacency to Island Gardens Marina, and a curated commercial and retail promenade of up to 25,000 square feet.
description: Arriving on a highly coveted 18.7-acre waterfront parcel along the MacArthur Causeway, the upcoming Watson Island Luxury Residential Project represents one of the most significant public-private redevelopments in South Florida history. Following an approved November 2024 voter referendum and subsequent City Commission authorization in July 2025, a joint venture between Terra and ESJ Capital Partners finalized the landmark $135 million land acquisition. The master plan introduces two striking 40-story towers slated to deliver between 400 and 600 ultra-luxury estate-level residences. While the elite global hospitality flag chosen to brand and manage the towers is strictly confidential, a formal name announcement is anticipated soon.
investmentThesis: This development unlocks the final major waterfront frontier positioned directly between Downtown Miami and Miami Beach. Helmed by Terra—renowned for delivering high-value architectural icons—the development framework includes a massive $37 million commitment to build a 13.3-acre public waterfront park focusing on ecoresiliency and biodiversity. Because the structural plans, floor layouts, and tier-one pricing schedules are not yet publicly released, registering during this unannounced land acquisition phase provides a critical ground-floor position before public sales open.
